items.title: 2 Days, 2 New US Cities: Lufthansa Adds Phoenix Airbus A350 Service In Record-Breaking Route Expansion
items.summary: Lufthansa will launch three weekly Munich–Phoenix flights in August 2027, adding Arizona to its network as the airline expands across the US.
